unit: The student can welcome a guest, introduce someone, make basic small talk, and politely offer a drink.
objective: Ask and answer simple questions about well-being.

title: Warm-up
subtitle: Greeting friends
question: What do you usually say when you see a friend or colleague?
starters: When I see a friend, I usually say...

title: Useful Language (Part 1)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and ask the student to repeat after you.
Read the definition and the example sentence.
Ask the check question to ensure the student understands.
Ask the student to create their own sentence using the word.

words.check: Which sentence means 'fine': A) I feel well, or B) I feel sick?
When would you say you're 'good': A) when you are happy, or B) when you are sad?

title: Useful Language (Part 2)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and ask the student to repeat.
Read the definition and example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make their own sentence using one of the words.

words.definition: A word used to ask a question.
words.check: Which question asks about a person's feelings: A) How are you? or B) What are you?
Which word means the present day: A) today or B) tomorrow?

title: Conversation Builder
goal: Greet your tutor and ask how they are.

linkers.use: Ask how the other person is doing.

model:
Tutor: Hello! How are you today?
Student: I am fine, thanks. And you?
Tutor: I am good, thanks for asking.

your_turn.teacher: Greet the student and ask how they are today.
your_turn.student: Answer the tutor, then return the question.

title: Let's practice
teacher_question: Imagine we're at the office and I'm your colleague. Ask me how I am, answer my question, and introduce someone to me. Use the prompts below to help you.

title: Real-world scenario
role_a: Student: You are at the office and see your colleague.
role_b: Tutor: You are the student's colleague.
problem: You want to say hello and introduce your friend to your colleague.
mission: Greet your colleague and ask, 'How are you today?'
Introduce your friend to your colleague.
start: Tutor: Oh, hi! It's great to see you today.

title: Wrap-Up
recap: Phrases: How are you? / I am fine. / And you?
Skill: Ask and answer simple questions about how someone is doing.
final_task: Use one of today's phrases to ask your tutor how they are doing.
challenge: Say 'How are you?' to a colleague or friend in English today.
